input: File my health insurance reimbursement claims

gold.taskDescription: The user wants to file one or more health insurance reimbursement claims with their insurer.

questions.title: Which insurance provider are you filing the claims with?
questions.description: Identify the specific health insurance company or plan the user needs to submit claims to.

questions.title: How many separate claims do you need to file?
questions.description: Determine the number of individual reimbursement claims the user is dealing with.

questions.title: What type of medical expenses are being claimed?
questions.description: Understand the nature of the expenses, such as doctor visits, prescriptions, lab tests, or hospital stays.

questions.title: Do you already have all receipts and documents ready?
questions.description: Find out whether the user has gathered the necessary supporting documents like bills, prescriptions, and doctor notes.

questions.title: What is the submission deadline for these claims?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a time-sensitive deadline driving urgency for this task.

questions.title: Does your insurer require online, app, or paper submission?
questions.description: Clarify the accepted filing method required by the user's insurance provider.

questions.title: Have you filed claims with this insurer before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's familiarity with the process to determine how much guidance or step-by-step support they will need.
